text: Validate patient MRN by querying Cerner FHIR Patient resource before note entry
Allow ward nurses to enter ward notes with required fields and content length validation
Save ward notes atomically to Cerner Millennium via FHIR POST and to a wound care CSV spreadsheet in SharePoint
Display immediate error toast and store note draft locally for 30 minutes if Cerner save fails
Retry failed spreadsheet writes asynchronously after Cerner confirms note save, with retry backoff and 30-second timeout
Show green confirmation toast with timestamp and nurse UPN after successful save to both Cerner and spreadsheet
Allow nurses to view a Notes tab listing all saved notes with status badges (Synced, Pending, Partial Sync) and note details
Enable nurses to edit a saved note within 15 minutes of first successful Cerner save, replacing original note in both Cerner and spreadsheet
Enforce read-only access to notes after 15-minute edit window, visible to writing nurse, unit nurses, and clinical leadership only
Filter and find patient notes by MRN in the wound care spreadsheet within 10 seconds using ISO 8601 timestamp for sorting
Prune wound care spreadsheet to retain only last 13 weeks of notes with daily automated deletion job
Enforce role-based access control for note entry and spreadsheet reading via Azure AD security groups
Persist note drafts in browser session storage until saved or discarded to prevent data loss on tab close or timeout
Log all save, retry, failure, and audit events to Azure Monitor with custom namespace
Store note data and retry state in Azure SQL database with encryption and secure configuration
Notify nurses with a yellow Partial Sync badge and warning toast if spreadsheet write fails after Cerner save
Allow nurses to manually retry failed spreadsheet writes and escalate persistent failures to IT support
Enable wound care readers to view the spreadsheet for trend spotting but require clinical actions to be documented in Cerner
Enforce compliance with HIPAA and HITRUST CSF including encryption at rest and in transit, audit logging, and least privilege access
Provide secure single sign-on via Azure AD with OAuth2 scopes limited to required FHIR permissions
